'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand border conflict]]
**[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand clashes]]
***[[Cambodia]]'s [[ambassador]] to the [[United Nations]], Chhea Keo, calls for an immediate and unconditional [[ceasefire]] with [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy9x99n79v8o (BBC News)]
***Twelve more deaths are reported in Cambodia while a [[Royal Thai Army|Thai]] soldier is shot dead on [[Cambodia–Thailand border|the border]] as both countries exchange [[artillery]] fire. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-armed-clash-border-eda96eb133a4561fa192029466da8dcf (AP)]
***Around 38,000 [[civilian]]s in Cambodia and almost 140,000 in Thailand [[emergency evacuation|flee their homes]] as fighting intensifies. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/26/cambodians-flee-border-with-thailand-as-clashes-continue-for-third-day (Al Jazeera)]
***Cambodia closes its [[airspace]] over the regions in the country where the conflict is being fought. [https://m.phnompenhpost.com/national/flights-rerouted-from-border-conflict-zone#:~:text=Cambodia%20has%20closed%20the%20airspace,the%20safety%20of%20their%20aircraft (''Phnom Penh Post'')]
***[[Royal Cambodian Army]] [[major general]] Duong Somneang is killed in an artillery strike on the frontline. [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/asean/40053125 (''Nation Thailand'')]
***The [[Royal Thai Navy]] engages Cambodian forces in the [[Gulf of Thailand]] after they launched attacks on [[Trat province]], Thailand. [https://world.thaipbs.or.th/detail/cambodia-opens-new-battle-front-attacking-thai-military-positions-in-trat/58335 (''Thai PBS World'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch an overnight [[drone warfare|drone]] and [[cruise missile]] attack on [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least three people and damaging multiple residential buildings. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russian-attack-kills-3-ukraines-city-dnipro-governor-says-2025-07-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**At least nine people are killed, including three attackers and a child, and 22 others are injured, including several critically, in a [[Assassination and terrorism in Iran|terrorist]] [[mass shooting]] and grenade attack at a courthouse in [[Zahedan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], Iran. [[Sunni]] [[jihadist]] [[separatist]] militant group [[Jaysh al-Adl]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/853987/attack-on-iran-courthouse-in-zahedan-leaves-multiple-dead (Kurdistan 24)] [https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-jaish-attack-courthouse-militants/33484498.html (RFERL)] [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-at-least-9-killed-in-attack-on-courthouse/a-73421304 (DW)]
*[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip famine]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[World Food Programme]] says 90,000 children and women are in need of urgent treatment in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cx2l2wk3zx0t (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Traverse City stabbing attack]]
**At least eleven people are injured, several critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a [[Walmart]] in [[Traverse City, Michigan|Traverse City]], [[Michigan]], United States. A suspect is in custody. '''Sports'''
*[[2024 Women's Africa Cup of Nations]]
**In [[association football]], the [[Nigeria women's national football team|Nigerian women's team]] wins a record-extending 12th [[Women's Africa Cup of Nations|Africa Cup of Nations]] title after defeating the host nation [[Morocco women's national football team|Morocco]] 3–2 in the final. Nigerian [[Forward (association football)|forward]] [[Rasheedat Ajibade]] is named the tournament's best player. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2025/jul/27/nigeria-win-10th-womens-africa-cup-of-nations-after-thrilling-comeback-against-morocco (''The Guardian'')]
